```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {
  toRows, presetRange, PRESETS, effectiveStart, anchorAndIndex, colorFor,
  formatEndLabel, yDomain, declutterValues, canSelect
} from "./js/series.js"

registry = (await fetch("data/series.json")).json()
registryIndex = new Map(registry.map((s, i) => [s.id, i]))
// Rate series join with their own panel in phase 6.
pickable = registry.filter((s) => s.kind === "level")
DEFAULT_SELECTION = ["sp500", "nasdaq"]
DEFAULT_PRESET = "10Y"
```

::: {.panel-sidebar}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected = {
  const form = html`<div class="picker"></div>`;
  form.value = DEFAULT_SELECTION.filter((id) => pickable.some((s) => s.id === id));
  const boxes = new Map();
  const update = () => {
    for (const [id, box] of boxes) {
      box.checked = form.value.includes(id);
      box.disabled = !canSelect(form.value, id);
    }
  };
  const emit = () => {
    update();
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  for (const category of [...new Set(pickable.map((s) => s.category))]) {
    const group = html`<fieldset class="picker-group"><legend>${category}</legend></fieldset>`;
    for (const s of pickable.filter((s) => s.category === category)) {
      const box = html`<input type="checkbox" value=${s.id}>`;
      box.onchange = () => {
        form.value = box.checked
          ? registry.map((r) => r.id).filter((id) => id === s.id || form.value.includes(id))
          : form.value.filter((id) => id !== s.id);
        emit();
      };
      boxes.set(s.id, box);
      group.append(html`<label class="picker-item">${box} ${s.name}</label>`);
    }
    form.append(group);
  }
  const clear = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">Deselect All</button>`;
  clear.onclick = () => {
    form.value = [];
    emit();
  };
  form.append(clear);
  update();
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof range = {
  const form = html`<div class="range"><div class="range-label">Date range</div></div>`;
  const buttons = new Map();
  const bar = html`<div class="btn-group btn-group-sm" role="group"></div>`;
  const from = html`<input type="date" class="form-control form-control-sm">`;
  const to = html`<input type="date" class="form-control form-control-sm">`;
  const set = (value) => {
    form.value = value;
    from.value = value.from;
    to.value = value.to;
    for (const [p, b] of buttons) b.classList.toggle("active", p === value.preset);
  };
  const emit = () => form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  for (const preset of Object.keys(PRESETS)) {
    const b = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">${preset}</button>`;
    b.onclick = () => {
      set({ ...presetRange(preset, registry), preset });
      emit();
    };
    buttons.set(preset, b);
    bar.append(b);
  }
  const edited = () => {
    if (!from.value || !to.value) return;
    set({ from: from.value, to: to.value, preset: null });
    emit();
  };
  from.onchange = edited;
  to.onchange = edited;
  form.append(
    bar,
    html`<label class="range-input">From ${from}</label>`,
    html`<label class="range-input">To ${to}</label>`
  );
  set({ ...presetRange(DEFAULT_PRESET, registry), preset: DEFAULT_PRESET });
  return form;
}
```
